title: Read a query string
summary: Fiber: Read a query string. Visit /page?n=3.
introduction: Query reads a query value and can take a default. Open GET /page.
learningObjectives: Read a query string with Fiber

blocks.text: Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Read a query string
blocks.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/page", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.JSON(fiber.Map{"page": c.Query("n", "1")}) })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

blocks.text: Query has no n input, so it returns the default string 1.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A query value remains text until you parse it.
